cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.

confusable: Not mere retrospective prediction: A claims the failure was an intended turning point in instruction and assigns the next activity as planned.
